name: Fukubiki! Triangle
original_name: ふくびき！トライアングル
source:
There is a shopping arcade, where a lot of stores are closed. The stores decide to hold a lottery event to gather customers. The first prize is... "You can spend two weeks with pretty sisters of president of the shopping arcade."

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一条商店大量歇业的商业街。为了招揽顾客，各家店铺决定举办抽奖活动。一等奖是…“可以和商业街会长漂亮的姐妹们共同生活两周。”

[摘自ErogeShop]
